messages:
Ivy C.: Heads up Zenith Labs sent INV-4107 but the PDF lists payee as "Redwood, LLC" instead of "Redwood Labs, Inc." and there's no PO. AP put it on hold. Anyone own this?
Mark D.: That's odd. Work was done for Labs team (model eval). PO 2024-ZEN-07 exists for Labs subscription but the vendor didn't include it. Invoice also shows a credit memo line for -$1,200 that wasn't in prior statements.
Elaine (AP): We need: (1) PO doc or evidence to auto-match subscription lines, (2) approver note for any non-PO services, (3) clarification on credit memo (is that vendor-side or applied incorrectly), and (4) correct legal entity on invoice or a reissue. AP won't pay until entity/legal is correct.
Mark D.: Cost owner for the ad-hoc evaluation hours is Mark D. I can approve the $3,600 services line. I'll paste this exact approval to the invoice: "Mark D. approves Zenith Labs INV-4107 evaluation services $3,600, GL=6500, cost center=ML-EVAL."
Ivy C.: I uploaded vendor email that references PO 2024-ZEN-07 but not the PO PDF. VendorOps, can you pull PO and ask them to reissue with correct payee and PO on header? Also ask about the -$1,200 credit line (vendor claims "prepaid discount").
VendorOps Bot: Auto-note: "Vendor record Zenith Labs Ltd missing invoice header mapping. Requested vendor reissue to correct legal entity and to attach PO 2024-ZEN-07. Also request documentation for credit memo. ETA vendor reply: 2 business days."
Elaine (AP): Mark please paste your approval text verbatim into the invoice comment. AP needs that for audit trail. Also we need a vendor confirmation about whether the credit should be applied to this invoice or a prior invoice; if applied here, AP will validate net amount.
Mark D.: Done I pasted approval comment to the invoice and attached Slack screenshot.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-4107 status: "held-no-po" -> "manual-review". Approver: Mark D. Tax/Entity flag: legal-entity-mismatch.
Ivy C.: VendorOps replied: vendor will reissue to "Redwood Labs, Inc." and will include PO 2024-ZEN-07. They say credit memo is a prepaid discount applied to current invoice. They've sent a cover email confirming that. Uploaded to invoice record.
Elaine (AP): Once vendor reissue is uploaded AP will re-validate amounts. If credit is confirmed as prepaid discount, AP will pay net after reissue. With Mark's approval and PO attached we can release payment. ETA: payment in next AP run (3 business days) after reissue confirmation.
Mark D.: Thanks. I'll follow up with vendor ops to confirm they pull PO document from our system and include it on reissue.
Ivy C.: Noted. Closing here unless AP reopens after reissue verification.
